source.source_text: Purpose: create a local Git commit from already staged content; never push or change remotes. Input: project_root:string, message:string<=500, expected_staged_diff_sha256?:string. Output: commit id, parent, staged-diff precondition and clean/dirty verification. Contract: L2 writes_local; scope mac.git.write; target project_root; timeout 30000ms; cap 512KiB; network none; filesystem write_allowed_project; secrets redacted; approval trusted_write; non-idempotent, guarded by expected staged hash. Phase 3 planned.
